title: 哈姆雷特 4-5~7 奧菲莉亞之殤
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, cold gothic atmosphere
characters: Ophelia, a slight young woman with very long loose fair hair, wide gentle eyes, in a simple pale flowing gown

panels.prompt: {characters} drifting barefoot through the throne room with wildflowers tangled in her disheveled hair, strewing petals on the flagstones, singing to no one, courtiers frozen in pity along the walls

dialogue.speaker: 奧菲莉亞
dialogue.text: （唱）他死了，不見了，姑娘，他死了，不見了；他頭上是青青的草，腳下是一塊石頭。
dialogue.en: (sings) He is dead and gone, lady, he is dead and gone; at his head a grass-green turf, at his heels a stone.

panels.prompt: King Claudius, a broad heavyset king with a neatly trimmed dark pointed beard, a wide gold crown, fur-trimmed brocade robes, a jeweled goblet in hand, and Queen Gertrude, a stately middle-aged queen with coiled auburn braids under a golden circlet, in a layered brocade gown, watching from the dais, both stricken

dialogue.speaker: 克勞地
dialogue.text: 悲哀來的時候，不是單個來的，是成群結隊來的——她的父親被殺、你的兒子遠放、人民議論紛紛，現在又是這個可憐的孩子。
dialogue.en: O Gertrude, Gertrude, when sorrows come, they come not single spies, but in battalions... poor Ophelia divided from herself and her fair judgment.

quote.en: When sorrows come, they come not single spies, but in battalions.

panels.prompt: the great doors bursting open, Laertes, a hot-blooded young nobleman with short dark curls and a thin moustache, a slender rapier at his hip, a short travel cloak, storming in sword drawn with an armed mob crowding behind him

dialogue.speaker: 雷歐提斯
dialogue.text: 你這萬惡的國王！把我的父親還給我！
dialogue.en: O thou vile king, give me my father!

panels.prompt: King Claudius, a broad heavyset king with a neatly trimmed dark pointed beard, a wide gold crown, fur-trimmed brocade robes, a jeweled goblet in hand, standing unarmed with both palms open, utterly calm before the levelled sword point

dialogue.speaker: 克勞地
dialogue.text: 冷靜點，好雷歐提斯。國王有神明護衛，叛逆只能在一邊乾瞪眼。告訴我你的父親怎麼死的——罪不在我。
dialogue.en: What is the cause, Laertes, that thy rebellion looks so giant-like?... There's such divinity doth hedge a king, that treason can but peep to what it would... I am guiltless of your father's death.

panels.prompt: {characters} re-entering with an apron full of wildflowers, pressing a sprig of rosemary into the trembling hands of Laertes, a hot-blooded young nobleman with short dark curls and a thin moustache, a slender rapier at his hip, a short travel cloak, his sword arm fallen slack

dialogue.speaker: 奧菲莉亞
dialogue.text: 這是迷迭香，是代表回憶的——親愛的，請你記著。這是三色堇，是代表想念的。
dialogue.en: There's rosemary, that's for remembrance; pray, love, remember: and there is pansies, that's for thoughts.

panels.prompt: close-up of the young nobleman's face crumbling from rage into grief as the flower girl drifts away singing, petals falling from her apron

dialogue.speaker: 雷歐提斯
dialogue.text: 憂愁、苦難、悲哀和地獄的磨折——在她身上，都變成了可憐可愛。
dialogue.en: Thought and affliction, passion, hell itself, she turns to favour and to prettiness.

panels.prompt: a shadowed private chamber, King Claudius, a broad heavyset king with a neatly trimmed dark pointed beard, a wide gold crown, fur-trimmed brocade robes, a jeweled goblet in hand, leaning close over a table conspiring with Laertes, a hot-blooded young nobleman with short dark curls and a thin moustache, a slender rapier at his hip, a short travel cloak, firelight on both faces

dialogue.speaker: 克勞地
dialogue.text: 殺你父親的人回來了。我們安排一場友誼比劍——他生性寬厚，不會檢查劍刃。你只要挑一柄沒有包頭的利劍……
dialogue.en: Hamlet comes back... We'll put on those shall praise your excellence... He, being remiss, most generous and free from all contriving, will not peruse the foils; so that, with ease... you may choose a sword unbated.

panels.prompt: close-up of two hands over the table: the young man's hand holding up a small vial of dark oil, the king's ringed hand resting on a wine chalice

dialogue.speaker: 雷歐提斯
dialogue.text: 我還有一服毒藥，劍尖只要沾上一點，見血就是死。
dialogue.en: I bought an unction of a mountebank, so mortal that, but dip a knife in it, where it draws blood no cataplasm so rare... can save the thing from death that is but scratch'd withal.

dialogue.speaker: 克勞地
dialogue.text: 再備一杯毒酒。萬一他躲過你的劍——那杯酒不會失手。
dialogue.en: I ha't... A chalice for the nonce, whereon but sipping, if he by chance escape your venom'd stuck, our purpose may hold there.

panels.prompt: dreamlike inset framed in flowing water: {characters} floating on her back in a dark brook beneath a leaning willow, her pale gown spread wide on the surface, garlands of wildflowers drifting around her, her face calm, mouth open in song

dialogue.speaker: 葛簇特
dialogue.text: 一株柳樹橫在溪水上。她編的花圈掉進水裡，她也跟著落下去——衣裳張開，把她像人魚一樣托在水面，她嘴裡還斷斷續續唱著古老的歌。
dialogue.en: There is a willow grows aslant a brook... an envious sliver broke; when down her weedy trophies and herself fell in the weeping brook. Her clothes spread wide; and, mermaid-like, awhile they bore her up: which time she chanted snatches of old tunes.

quote.en: There is a willow grows aslant a brook.

panels.prompt: Laertes, a hot-blooded young nobleman with short dark curls and a thin moustache, a slender rapier at his hip, a short travel cloak turned sharply away against a stone window arch, fist pressed to his mouth, while behind him the queen's outstretched hand hovers not quite touching his shoulder, rain streaking the dark glass

dialogue.speaker: 雷歐提斯
dialogue.text: 可憐的奧菲莉亞，你的水已經太多了，我禁住我的眼淚。
dialogue.en: Too much of water hast thou, poor Ophelia, and therefore I forbid my tears.

panels.prompt: the empty brook at dusk seen from the bank, the leaning willow black against a fading sky, a single flower garland caught on a branch trailing in the current, no figure anywhere

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.text: 歌聲沉了下去。復仇的計畫，也定了下來。
dialogue.en: The song sinks below the water; and the plot is sealed.
